## Design

### 2026-10-03 — Created the complete schematic for the 3-key macropad in EasyEDA Pro.

**3h**

Created the complete schematic for the 3-key macropad in EasyEDA Pro.

- Added the Raspberry Pi Pico component footprint and 3 Cherry MX switch footprints (U2, U3, U4).
- Mapped Switch 1 (U2) to Pico GPIO 1 (Pin 2).
- Mapped Switch 2 (U3) to Pico GPIO 2 (Pin 4).
- Mapped Switch 3 (U4) to Pico GPIO 3 (Pin 5).
- Connected the common pin of all three switches to Pico GND (Pin 3).
- Verified net connections and pin assignments before transferring the design to the PCB layout editor.

### 2026-10-03 — Focused on the PCB layout, component placement, and trace routing in EasyEDA Pro.

**4h**

Focused on the PCB layout, component placement, and trace routing in EasyEDA Pro.

- Placed the three Cherry MX footprints with standard key-pitch spacing and aligned the Raspberry Pi Pico header pads.
- Routed the signal traces from switches U2, U3, and U4 to Pico GPIO pins 1, 2, and 3 using 0.254mm (10 mil) copper traces.
- Created a shared ground net connecting the pin 2 switch terminals directly back to physical Pin 3 (GND) on the Pico.
- Added a bottom-layer ground copper pour (GND net) to ensure low impedance and reduce signal noise.
- Adjusted clearances around switch mounting holes and solder pads to prevent solder bridges during through-hole assembly.
